title: Unseen Risks of Clinical Speech-to-Text Systems: Transparency, Privacy, and Reliability Challenges in AI-Driven Documentation

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing existing literature to evaluate automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance degradation and Word Error Rate (WER) disparities for atypical speech patterns, including dysarthric speech, stuttered speech, and speech affected by neurodegenerative diseases.
Reviewing empirical studies to assess transcription error rate disparities for individuals with accents, non-standardized English, and multilingual speech patterns.
